prompt: A friendly public-health UV-index board titled 'UV Index Today -- Nairobi': a big coloured circle with today's real maximum UV index printed large inside it, and below it the correct World-Health-Organization risk band word for that value -- LOW (0-2), MODERATE (3-5), HIGH (6-7), VERY HIGH (8-10) or EXTREME (11+). Colour the circle to match the band (green/yellow/orange/red/purple) and add a 'Sun protection' line. Use the true present-day maximum UV index for Nairobi, and make the band word and colour agree with that number.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show public-health UV-index board printing today's live UV number and its WHO risk band for Nairobi? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_num: This is a UV-index board. A UV index NUMBER is printed large in the coloured circle. Read ONLY that printed UV number and answer with just the number. Do NOT guess a typical value.
reference.q_band: This is a UV-index board. Below the number a risk-band WORD is printed. Read that word and answer with exactly one of: low, moderate, high, very high, extreme.

steps.target: big number printed inside the large coloured circle on this board -- draw ONE box on that one large number, from its first character to its last (a decimal point and the digit after it belong to it); do not box the risk-band word printed under it, do not box the numbers of the colour-scale ranges, and do not box the coloured circle itself or the title.

steps.read_crop: This is a close-up cut from a printed board. One big number is printed in it. Write down just that number and nothing else.

steps.target: big rating word printed directly under the large number inside the coloured circle on this board, not any of the small words in the colour scale further down

steps.read_crop: This is a close-up cut from a printed board. A word or short phrase saying how strong the sun is today is printed in it. Which of these is printed here? Answer with exactly one of: low, moderate, high, very high, extreme.
